C380  Heart
C381  Anterior mediastinum
C382  Posterior mediastinum
C383  Mediastinum, NOS
C388  Overlapping lesion of heart, mediastinum and pleura

**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Soft Tissues,* pages 157-161.
* Primary sites C380 and C388 are not listed in this chapter of the UICC manual; however, they are included in this schema and TNM staged if appropriate histology criteria are met

**Note 2:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Heart, Mediastinum* chapter on page 158 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=158).
